description.ncbi_summary: Predicted to enable calcium ion binding activity and calcium sensitive guanylate cyclase activator activity. Predicted to be involved in signal transduction. Predicted to be located in photoreceptor disc membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2022]

uniprot_function.text: Regulates the activity of retinal membrane guanylyl cyclase 1 (GUCY2D/RetGC1) in a Ca(2+)-dependent manner. At low intracellular Ca(2+) concentrations, GCAP3 binds to and allosterically activates RetGC1, stimulating cGMP synthesis and restoring cGMP levels in photoreceptors during the recovery phase of phototransduction. At high Ca(2+) concentrations, inhibits RetGC1 activation, contributing to the Ca(2+)-dependent negative feedback loop that maintains photoreceptor sensitivity (PubMed:10037746, PubMed:16626734, PubMed:35328663). Exclusively expressed in cone photoreceptors where it plays a modulatory role in the recovery phase of phototransduction by fine-tuning Ca(2+) sensitivity. Its role may be redundant or complementary to GCAP1 and GCAP2 in cones (PubMed:10037746, PubMed:16626734).
